# heal-my-goap

> Production-grade zero-token symbolic GOAP planning with LLM-powered self-healing.

## Docs
- Getting Started: /getting-started/installation/
- Core Concepts: /getting-started/concepts/
- Tool Registration Guide: /user-guide/tool-ingestion/
- Delta Observer Guide: /user-guide/delta-observer/
- Self-Healing Guide: /user-guide/self-healing/
- API Reference — GoapEngine: /api-reference/engine/
- API Reference — Models: /api-reference/models/

## Core Modules
- GoapEngine: Orchestrator for planning, execution, observation, and self-healing
- action_from_tool: Convert Python callables into GOAP actions
- DeltaObserver: Runtime state delta observer for automated effect learning
- GapAnalyzer: Diagnostic gap isolation for missing predicates
- LLMSynthesizer: OpenRouter bridge action synthesis with retry memory
- SystemSensors: 28+ live OS metrics (RAM, CPU, disk, network, battery)
- ActionStorage: Deduplicated JSON action persistence
- SandboxExecutor: Subprocess code sandbox with AST safety checks

## Installation
uv add heal-my-goap

## Quick Import
from heal_my_goap import GoapEngine, Action, Goal, WorldState, action_from_tool, DeltaObserver
